verdict.rationale: incident.io ships built-in AI agents (Investigations, Scribe, Suggestions/Summaries, post-mortem AI drafting) that users delegate incident-response tasks to directly within the product, e.g. investigating root cause across code/telemetry, drafting postmortems, and suggesting updates/follow-ups. These are native features, not just an MCP client integration. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of agent quality beyond vendor docs, and clearer detail on how a user explicitly 'delegates' vs. the agent auto-triggering.
